_comment: sha1 (LF-normalized, utf8) of RETIRED seed-废案 bodies. materializeSeedFeian overwrites a live workspace file whose content hashes to an entry here — that is how a seed REVISION reaches existing workspaces, while user-edited files and dream-created 废案 (which never match) stay untouched (D7). When you revise a seed: hash the OLD body (git show HEAD:…, CRLF→LF, sha1 hex) and append it under the language's list BEFORE regenerating prompt assets. Never remove entries — every historical body must stay recognizable as superseded.
